name: rune shaper

prerequisites.desc: Spellcasting feature or Rune Carver background

desc: You’ve learned how to etch magical runes into your equipment:

- Comprehensive Languages: You learn the comprehend languages spell. You can cast it without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

- Rune Magic: Whenever you finish a long rest, you can scribe a number of runes equal to your proficiency bonus onto your equipment. Each rune must be different. For each rune you scribe, you learn the spell associated with it. You can cast each of these spells once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).
